fusions.name: Clearing Bound
fusions.desc: Leaps onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, up to 2 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Nipping Hop
fusions.desc: A biting kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Over the Hedge
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: High Landing
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
